# quarantine

This R package provides data and an interactive Shiny application to explore COVID-19 quarantine breach data in Australia for **ETC5523 Assignment 4**.

## Installation

You can install the development version of this package from GitHub with:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("laihoangson/rshiny")
```

## Example Usage

Once installed, you can load the package and launch the interactive Shiny app.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(quarantine)  

# Launch the interactive application
launch_app()

# You can also directly access the data
head(breaches_data)
```

A full documentation website created with **pkgdown** is available here:
